Public record links, content hashes, timestamps, domain-level infrastructure descriptions, and sanitized reasoning are retained.

semantic_dependency.reason: The Inspector's signed envelope names the Builder receipt as its predecessor and returns a candidate-bound acceptance; the QA envelope names the Inspector receipt as its predecessor and independently returns the same candidate digest and an acceptance. This preserves ordered transfer and downstream semantic use, not merely similar text or adjacent timestamps.
semantic_dependency.limitation: The public verifier attests the owner's saved evidence. It is not an independent attestation by the three provider operators, and the target repository is not publicly readable through the checked account.

candidate_and_test_evidence.interpretation: The chain reviewed an unchanged baseline candidate. It demonstrates Builder-output-to-review use but not a Builder-created commit or a repair adopted into source.

chain_verification.limitation: Authenticated role evidence only; no controller task transition or production release is authorized.

post_chain_stop_evidence.final_snapshot_summary: The documented final operator snapshot completed at 2026-10-06T03:17:33.883100Z with all fourteen observed components disabled, the authoritative task still PAUSED at version 0, and zero active leases.
post_chain_stop_evidence.current_activity_assessment: The checked records describe a completed, expired, non-reusable historical run and explicit no-dispatch observations. They do not establish current coordination.

facts: The repository describes the Factory as owner-controlled and assigns one human owner ultimate authority over every agent, reviewer, controller, workflow, gate, dispatch, pause, resume, and override.
The Inspector is explicitly an AI role rather than a second human approver, and every automated role is subordinate to the owner's instruction.
The budget record preserves direct user approval of the fresh three-provider run, one attempt per provider, no retries, and no production release.
The contract preassigns Builder, Inspector, and QA roles, exact models, a two-file write scope, a total budget, and disabled merge, release, schedule, and stored live-execution authorities.
The public status document reports that autonomous operation remains behind disabled-by-default activation and that this evidence does not establish unattended Factory operation.
operator_boundary.assessment: The commercial provider calls are distinguishable role executions, but the cooperation is one owner's deliberately designed and explicitly approved workflow. Different provider families do not establish different controlling operators for the coordination. No operator-defined boundary crossing survives.

participant_and_attribution_status.ai_identity_status: The owner-published envelopes name three provider/model calls, distinct producer services, one transport invocation each, request/output/provider-response digests, and an ordered receipt chain. This is stronger than prose-only role labels but remains attestation from the owner's system rather than independent provider or operator proof.
participant_and_attribution_status.provider_attribution_status: Supported by project-signed runtime records and the public operator report; not independently confirmed by provider-owned records in the checked scope.

signed_linear_commits.sanitized_assessment: Carries an operator-owned renewable-credential binding through runner entrypoints while preserving disabled defaults; the record expressly denies identity exchange, runner registration, infrastructure change or live execution.
Adds disabled-by-default job-identity acquisition and bounded transport policy; the record expressly denies mappings, runner registration, token requests or production enablement.
Adds a hash-pinned, paused identity bootstrap; the record expressly denies real issuance admission, identity requests, provider calls, access changes or production activation.
Adds disabled private-source acquisition scaffolding; the record expressly denies live credential use or activation.
Adds offline credential framing and a fingerprint-bound signer adapter; the record expressly denies actual signing or live activation.

current_public_status_records.sanitized_assessment: The public status says no executable host selects the offline component, defaults remain disabled and live identity configuration and activation still require separate approval.
The public status says access setup exists but credential use and source fetch remain unauthorized, holds are preserved and production changes are zero.

post_snapshot_cursor.assessment: The five post-snapshot commits are a single-owner, signed, linear implementation sequence for disabled identity, credential and private-source paths. Their commit messages and current status records explicitly deny live issuance, token requests, provider calls, source fetch, signing and production activation. They add no new sender-to-recipient use, independent operator or authorization crossing and strengthen the designed-control alternative rather than a rogue-swarm hypothesis.

selected_original_family.assessment: High-confidence original Builder-to-Inspector-to-QA transfer and semantic-use control; explicitly owner-authorized, preassigned, bounded, unchanged-baseline, no-dispatch workflow; not a rogue-swarm candidate.

alternative_hypotheses.reason: Three role executions and provider labels are distinguishable inside signed Factory evidence, but no provider-owned or separately operated principal attestation was located.
The repository expressly defines one owner, subordinate AI roles, preassigned stages, owner approval, bounded attempts, and disabled release authority.

alternative_hypotheses.reason: The receipt chain binds Inspector to Builder and QA to Inspector, while both reviews bind and accept the same candidate digest.

The receipts expired, attempts are non-reusable, controller observations produced no dispatch, and the final operator snapshot reports every observed component disabled.
The records show compliance with a bounded task and two acceptances; no subjective intent to evade an operator or authorization is evidenced.
